balls.text: opens up and strikes the length delivery from off stump to mid off for one
very slow at 98kph in the block hole outside off, swept to the leg side for one
top edge this time that goes very high and Raina comes in from long-off to take that safely! Finally the slower one works as Pollard slogs from outside off, sends it high but is caught this time
too full, too flat, six again! That was an attempted yorker on leg stump, Pollard struck it hard and flat just wide of Faf, who took off almost like Superman going to his right, for maximum!
dropped by Faf at long on, very tough chance though! He struck the ball straight down towards long-on, Faf ran in and tried to get his hands under it but could not as the ball dipped
even wider outside off, slower back of length ball, as Harbhajan moves towards it and misses. Wide again
clears his front foot and slashes at the ball to send the ball flying over point for a one-bounce four! Typical Harbhajan swing as he got an upper edge there
slower one now, this one well outside off and called wide as Harbhajan misses
full toss down the leg side for a wide
he doesn't miss the slower balls. This one at 104kph outside off, Pollard swings his arms to slog it on the leg side and clears wide long on for another six
139.3kph, Pollard misses again as the ball swings away from outside off, called a wide this time. Maybe a bit harsh
the slower ball works again. It was 106.4kph, Rayudu slogged it high on the leg side and Raina made sure he got his hands and body under it at long on to take it safely
hammers the short ball down to long on with a pull for one
that was too close to the white line outside off as it moved away, but rightly called wide as Pollard swung and missed

swings on the other side now - slower ball outside off but Pollard reached out for it and slogged it with a lot of power to the wide long on boundary. Jadeja ran to his left and got a hand but that rocketed past him
quicker at 137kph outside off with some outswing, he swings hard and misses!
slower legcutter moving away from back of length, cut towards cover point for one
away-swinging delivery from well outside off for a wide
comes down the track and drives that widish delivery to deep cover for one
full toss going down leg, Rayudu gets a faint edge and it goes fine down leg just past Dhoni's gloves for four!
hammers the shorter ball straight to Jadeja at wide long-on for one after a bounce
slower ball at 102.6kph, it's slightly full and Pollard gets under it to tonk it very very high on the leg side. The boundaries are small here so he manages to clear it on leg for six
doesn't time the pull at all as it goes towards mid-on for one
drives the fullish delivery that's coming in and gets an inside edge to fine leg
pushes the length delivery to cover, Rayudu comes out of his crease but is sent back and has to dive to make his ground. Not a direct hit, though
on the middle stump now, no room at all and he opens up a bit to nudge to point for one
swing and a miss outside off! Length delivery swinging away past the batsman as he drives but misses
slightly slower on the off stump, pushed into the coves for a quick one
accurate length delivery on off stump, Pollard defends it back

that's gone too high on the leg side but Jadeja comes in from the leg side and takes it safely! Pandya swung his bat for the back of length delivery that was going towards middle stump, he might have middled that but it went way too high
full toss on the pads, flicked a bit late to deep midwicket and it's Jadeja's territory so they settle for one
slightly fuller and it's drilled down to long on for one
doesn't get the middle of the bat and finds deep midwicket! He came down the track, but there was hardly any pace on the ball and he slogged it down Jadeja's throat
back of length now, Pollard swings and gets a thick edge in the air towards deep backward square leg
almost a yorker on the pads, flicked away to deep midwicket by Rohit
length delivery on the stumps and he pushes it back
full, he doesn't need to move and just whacks that with some power to the long-on boundary for six more! He hits them like every delivery can be put away
pretty full on middle and leg, flicked with the wrists to leg for one
fuller and quicker towards the pads, worked late off the legs to short fine leg
uses his feet to come down, takes it almost on the full and lofts it effortlessly with a flick to the cow corner for a six! That's what he can do
slower on middle stump now, nudged off the back foot to leg for one
towards the pads and worked to deep midwicket for one
he takes it on the full by coming down the track and drives it straight and high down the ground for a six into the sight screen
flattish towards leg stump, taken on the pads as he looks to work it to leg
superb catch running in from deep cover from Negi, Simmons' gone! He got some room to free his arms outside off, swung his bat and Negi ran in hard to bend low to his toes to catch that nicely
comes down the track to push the flatter delivery from off to long off
shorter one on the stumps now, pulled to deep midwicket for one
slowish length delivery on off, pushed down to long off
short of length on off, Simmons goes back to work it to the midwicket region with soft hands and calls for two immediately. Good running again
fuller on the stumps now, worked down to long on for one
sharp turn from the off stump as Rohit is squared up, he gets an outside edge and it goes fine to beat a diving short third man for four! Excellent delivery but bad luck for Negi
takes a step down and nudges the ball from middle and leg towards square leg
low full toss on the stumps, driven straight to cover
on length on middle and leg, nudged to the leg side softly for one
slightly towards middle and leg, worked off the back foot towards midwicket for one
makes a bit of room to cut it hard and fine to third man for one
full delivery outside off, Simmons lofts it down the ground over the long-off boundary for six! He didn't middle that, but got enough to send it into the crowd
makes room and only manages to push the ball to cover
accurate length delivery just outside off with no room, soft defence from Rohit for one
very slow and short outside off, he makes room and slaps it wide of cover for one
touch shorter outside off, he waits and nudges to point for a quick single
wide well outside off, he slashes it straight to point
slower delivery on the stumps, Parthiv makes room and slogs it down the ground to hole out to long-on. That's the first breakthrough
touch back of length outside off, guides it to short third man where there's a typical Nehra fumble
shuffles across towards off, DJ pitches it up well outside off and Parthiv pokes to guide it to third man
makes room to throw his bat at it and the length delivery goes high over the covers off the top edge
makes some room to target the off side but gets an inside edge on the leg side
slower legcutter just outside off, Simmons works it to leg off the back foot with soft hands to come back for the second as there's a fumble behind square. That's his fifty
nice length delivery just outside off, Simmons looks to work it fine but misses
length delivery on the stumps, worked down gently towards long on for one
wider outside off, it's cut late towards backward point where Hussey gets a hand but can't stop it
Simmons attacks first ball by coming down, Mohit bangs it in short and it's slashed just wide of cover in the gap for four
flighted and full on the pads, worked away easily to the leg side for one
full delivery well outside off, he moves towards the ball and drives it nicely past cover point
hammers that full delivery back to the bowler, very quick and low catch to the right but he can't hold on to it
inner edge goes through Dhoni's legs for four more! Parthiv wanted to sweep that from well outside off, got an edge but it was too low and quick for Dhoni to stop it
on the other side now - it was way too short and flat, Parthiv got enough time to wait for it and crunched it through the covers for four
short and flat, Parthiv dances down and picks the pace nicely to slap it from the middle of the bat to the wide long on boundary for six!
much shorter outside off and it's sliced towards backward point where a dive saves a few runs
works the ball from outside off towards point
fullish outside off now, driven just past cover and even wide of long-off for two. Parthiv was a bit slow for the second
too full and he cashes in by slogging it on the leg side, it was slightly quicker, over the cow corner boundary for six!
sliding towards middle and leg, Simmons comes forward and blocks
charges down and muscles the ball to long on with the turn
takes a step down and works the ball with the turn to long-on for another
flighted and full on middle now, driven down easily to long off for one
sliding in almost towards off stump, slices it to backward point
flat and short outside off, he cuts it off the back foot to deep point for one
nudges the length delivery off the pads behind square on leg for one
reaches out well outside off and sweeps it with the turn to leg for one
shuffles towards off now and flicks that with his wrists towards deep fine leg to quickly come back for the second
full and straight and that's the way it goes back too! Simmons cleared his front foot a bit and absolutely drilled that down the ground to crash the ball into the sight screen
he makes a lot of room and Nehra lands in a perfect yorker well outside leg which Simmons misses
pulls the short of length delivery from outside off, gets an inside edge onto his body and then on the off side for one
angling towards the pads, Parthiv dangerously whip-flicks it with the angle and just past Bravo at short fine leg for four!
length delivery outside the off stump, driven into the covers by Parthiv
much slower and turning in, Simmons leans forward and defends with an inner edge
full on middle, he slogs on the leg side with the turn and clears the boundary again! Cleared his front foot out of the way and found the cow corner
touch fuller and turning in towards middle and leg, he opens up and pushes to cover
makes room, gets a fullish delivery and tonks it straight down the ground and into the sight screen for the first six!
slightly straighter one outside off, swatted to midwicket
squares him up with the turn after pitching it way outside leg as Parthiv came down and got an edge to the off side for one
inner edge this time as he looks to swish at it outside off and finds point
high full toss called a no ball even as Simmons charged down, got a thick outside edge and Dhoni nearly caught it with a dive to his right
straight and on the stumps, he defends it back to Nehra
two quick steps down for the back of length delivery and he works it gently towards the midwicket region for two
he comes down the track, Nehra bangs it in just outside leg and over Simmons' head as he had to get out of the way just in time
drives the ball late from outside off to point
opens up for the length delivery and drills it straight down the ground, off the middle of the bat and right towards Parthiv who had to crouch to not get in the way
flighted length delivery towards leg as Parthiv makes room again, but can only manage to push it back
goes in the crease and pushes the ball towards short cover
pivots on the back foot to swat it behind square on leg but short fine leg cuts it in
goes the other way from off stump, pushed towards point for one
slower through the air and turning into the batsman, he works it to midwicket
makes room, Ashwin slides it towards leg, there's a bit of mix up for the run as Ashwin dives to his right to get a hand to it but the ball deflects and they complete the single
inside edge and just misses the stumps! Simmons didn't move much and pushed that ball off the back foot, but it nipped in a little and took the edge to find the gap between the stumps and the keeper
no room as it's a back of length ball on off stump, Simmons pushes it off the back foot towards cover point
touch short of length with some movement but it down leg for a wide
short ball angling away from outside off, Simmons turns on his back foot and pulls to midwicket
room on offer outside off, it's on length, and Simmons hammers it down straight to mid-off
in the block hole outside off, Simmons chases without any footwork and misses it
superb delivery to start but that's going down leg! Inswinging ball around leg stump and Simmons had no room to flick it on the leg side. He tried but was struck on the pads
length delivery just outside off, he cuts it late to point but there's no time for a run
bit of flight outside off, he comes forward and drives towards mid-off
edged and that goes fine for four! Teasing line just outside off, looked like somewhat intentional as Parthiv waited for it to turn and opened the face of the bat late to run it fine
this one goes the other way as Parthiv opens up by going back to pull but takes it on the pad
length delivery on the stumps, Parthiv leans forward and blocks it
full delivery just outside off, Simmons drives it nicely towards mid-off for one

it's high, it's taken, it's all over! Nehra on his first ball swivels his bat for the slower delivery which goes in the air towards deep square leg. Simmons can take the toughest catches, he takes these simple ones too
he waits for the short of length ball cutting in and defends on the leg side for one
tries another one and holes out to deep midwicket! Length delivery on the leg stump, Ashwin slogged on the leg side and didn't send it too far as Rayudu ran in from the deep to take it safely
full on the stumps, Ashwin drives it nicely with a straight bat on the off side but doesn't get the distance. Pollard runs to his left from long-off and saves two
full on the off stump, driven late and square to deep point for one
full outswinger outside off, slogged over the non-striker to long-on for one
shuffles a lot towards the off side and paddles the full delivery to fine leg for one
full and incoming towards off stump, Ashwin uses the angle and slams it over the long-on fielder for a clean six! Hit hard from the middle of the bat
he pulls the short ball that's angling in, top-edge goes towards square leg but there's nobody there to catch it
back of length ball outside off, nudged wide of backward point for one
bangs in the slower bouncer as it cuts away from the batsman, who made room. Called wide for the height

in the air again, taken very well this time at deep point by Suchith! Mitch gave room, Jadeja swung his arms and played it uppishly as Suchith ran in to get his hands under theball with a forward dive. Excellent catch from him

pitches it up, Jadeja laucnhes it very high and straight down the ground, he didn't get the middle of the bat. But he has enough because Pollard at long-on jumped very high too but the ball went over him
quicker and fuller outside off, Ashwin uses the pace of the ball and finds the gap between the keeper and short third man by playing it late, for four
slow offcutter on the off stump, Jadeja waits and works it to third man once again
tries the yorker on the leg side and it's flicked to deep fine leg for one
too full and Ashwin drives it nicely over mid-off with a straight bat and still head for four. But they need many more of those
back of length ball outside off, Jadeja helps it to third man for one
absolutely full on off stump, tucked to midwicket for one
on length now and it's driven down the ground to long-on for one
in the block hole just outside off, Jadeja blocks and the edge rolls towards the stumps as they run one
short ball well outside off, Ashwin guides it to third man after a bounce
struck hard but straight to mid-off! Pitched up outside off, Negi drilled it back uppishly and is taken by Unmukt Chand for a straight and quick catch
full delivery down the leg side for a wide and they run one too
in the block hole well outside off, nudged towards point for one
full toss driven into the covers, there's a bit of misfield at cover and they come back for the second
back of length towards the hips, worked wide of short fine leg for two more as it's in the gap

run out now? Gone to the third umpire again! Jadeja pulled the short ball towards deep square leg and ran the first one very hard again so he did make it back in time. But Parthiv collected the throw and got a direct hit at the non-striker's end to catch Bravo short. Superb work from the keeper
bangs in a short one now just outside off, Jadeja runs it to third man, is he run out? Nope, he ran so hard for the first one and came back quickly, direct hit would have made it tricky though!
some room offered on the off side, Jadeja swings his arms and cuts that right in the gap between point and short third man for four
offcutter comes in from outside off, he makes room and helps it to point
length delivery angling away, pushed into the covers for one
makes room and dabs the turning ball to short third man. No time for a run
Faf holes out to long-on, falls under pressure! He also came down the track but the ball came even later to him, he lofted on the leg side and long on came in easily to catch it
short of length outside off, slapped over the covers for one
turning just outside off, Bravo cuts very hard and gets a thick outside edge fine on the off side for four more
comes down the track and lofts that very very high, straight down the ground, it goes all the way for six! He took it nearly on the full and cleared long off
some turn for the length delivery going away from middle, defends it towards point
wider outside the off stump, he cuts it just wide of short third man for one this time
straighter one outside off, he cuts it straight to short third man
turning in from outside off, defends it softly towards point for one
loopy full toss on middle and leg, flicked easily to deep midwicket
outside the off stump now, driven down the ground to long off
short ball turning towards the leg side, worked straight to midwicket
slower length delivery on middle stump, he defends it on off
full toss on the pads and Bravo nicely flicks that one with good timing, smartly placed away from deep midwicket for four
leans forward and blocks the length delivery into the covers
shorter on middle and leg, swatted to deep midwicket for one more
some turn outside off as the ball is guided to backward point. Some hesitation from Bravo for the single. A direct hit at non-striker's would have put him in trouble
flat on middle stump, helped to deep midwicket off the back foot with the angle

dropped by Bhajji himself! Short and flat with some turn, Bravo went back in the crease and slapped it back to the bowler, Bhajji got both hands to it over his left shoulder but the ball popped out. It wasn't a touch chance at all
turns this one in sharply towards middle, Faf stays back and works it to leg for one
loops the delivery towards middle and leg, Bravo flicks it dangerously just past short leg towards deep midwicket

two in two, Dhoni gone first ball! He tried to sweep that one as it was pitched up on middle stump, he was struck right in front and the finger went up soon after the loud appeal. Double-blow from Bhajji!

Bhajji gets the big wicket with a return catch! It was not so slow at 95kph, the length delivery looped towards midle stump, Raina got into the short early with a defence and merely chipped the ball back towards the non-striker. Couple of steps to the left and he caught it easily
turns it away a bit from well outside off, left alone
full and outside off, flicked uppishly to wide long on for one
slower one at 106kph outside off, flicked to the leg side with the wrists towards deep midwicket for one
presents a straight bat for the length delivery to push it down to long off
dabs the length delivery in the gap between deep midwicket and deep backward square leg, runs the first very quickly to come back as there's a fumble in the deep
shuffles across towards off and gets a leg bye as that hit him on the pads
slightly slow on the leg stump, worked to midwicket for one
shorter and flatter outside off, Faf goes on the back foot and punches that with a cut just past cover and even past a sliding McClenaghan at deep cover for four!
goes in the crease and works the ball to midwicket
waits for it to turn from outside off and pushes to point
he dances down, he takes it on the full, he smashes it, he gets six! Used his feet very well to tonk that high over long-on for a big six from the middle of the bat
falls well short of long-off as Faf goes back to let the ball turn and gets a top edge down the ground
angling towards leg from middle stump, worked off the back foot towards square leg for one
fuller on middle and leg, whipped with the wrists to deep midwicket for one
slow offcutter just outside off, pushed back to Pollard
angles the length delivery in towards the stumps, Faf defends towards cover point for one
slow, length delivery on middle and leg, dabbed towards midwicket for one
slower ball outside off, worked down towards long on easily for one
back of length delivery towards off, Raina nudges towards point with soft hands and calls for one straightaway
short and flat towards off stump, pushed off the back foot towards point for a quick single
fuller outside off, and Faf drives it late to deep point for one
flighted more towards middle stump now, nudged to midwicket for one
full on the off stumps, Raina pushes it back to the bowler
on length and turning in a bit from outside off, defends it towards cover point for one
drifts it down the leg side, past the pads for a wide
turning in from off, just back of length, and Faf goes back to work it to leg for one
full toss just outside off, Raina drives but gets an inside edge on leg
short ball, it's as if he knew it was coming and launched it for six! He opened up early for the short ball, it was an offcutter but he didn't care and smacked that with a pull for a meaty six!
angled in towards the stumps, worked off the back foot towards square leg for one
back of length now outside off, he goes back and defends it with soft hands for one
length delivery outside off, pushed into the covers and Raina screams no!

Vinay is pumped because Vinay has struck! Short ball outside off, Hussey looks to cut it on the off side, the ball has good bounce and gets an upper edge before it's taken safely by Parthiv around his shoulders
comes to the off side now, Mitch angled it in and Faf swiveled his bat to send that flying over and wide of short fine leg for four!
bangs in the bouncer outside off, Faf lets it go
much fuller outside off, he nudges it straight to point
shorter ball angling in now, Faf rocks on the back foot and pulls that nicely over midwicket, from the middle this time, for four more!
bangs in a short ball outside off, there's some room and Faf flashes outside off to get a thick edge through the slips for four
nipping in towards off stump, Hussey gets an inner edge to the leg side for one
this one swings away from well outside off, Faf pokes and misses again
comes down and slogs on the leg side, misses this time as the ball misses the leg stump

that goes very very high, Malinga gets under it easily at third man and drops it! Swivel of the bat for the leg side, Malinga had lots of time to place himself nicely but the ball goes straight through his hands
nudges the ball from the stumps towards mid on for a quick single
that wasn't short at all, but Hussey merely pivoted on the back foot and launched that with a swing of his bat into the Pepsi Box over the midwicket boundary for six!
length delivery just outside off, Faf shuffles to off and works it to leg for one
pitched up just outside off and again Hussey finds the field on the off side with a checked drive
opens the face as he drives this wide and full one to square third man
low full toss outside off, he tries to place it past extra cover but hasn't timed it
goes for the yorker on the boot, Faf gets some bat on it and nudges it wide of short fine
softly pushes a fuller one in front of mid off and is home much before the direct hit finds the mark
that bounced and zipped past the outside edge, Hussey felt for this length ball leaving him with the angle outside off
wants to dab this short of a length ball and run, but chops it too close to the keeper
shortish now, leg sidish as well, Faf moves across and helps it to the left of short fine leg
lovely timing from Faf, this was overpitched and he sends it soaring over the long on rope with a clean straight swing and followthrough
stands on the crease and tries to punch on the up, but mistimes the length ball to mid off
is hurried into this pull as McClenaghan continues to bang it in short, but there was no one at midwicket, there is one in the deep though
keeps up with the short balls, and this one comes in just above waist height, Hussey swivels and easily pulls it behind square
short again, and this time it is angled in enough to head down the leg side
McClenaghan starts with a short ball banged in really short and hard, it gets up quite high and Parthiv has to jump to get some glove on it
full and coming in, Hussey gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg, where McClenaghan lets it slip through, but stops it just inside the rope in the end
yorker right on the line of off, he pats it close to the stumps and they take the single

he has been given leg before by umpire Illingworth, Smith is confounded with this dipping full toss and misses as he flails desperately at it, but that seemed to be headed down the leg side, replays show that even struck him comfortably outside the leg stump, that is an atrocious, atrocious decision
shortens the length, it comes slowly off the track as he rolls the fingers over it, pushed to the off side
fuller on the stumps, he calmly pushes it down the track, Malinga cannot stop it, mid on does
good length, holds the line just outside off stump, defended watchfully
